explication: React is a UI library whose main user workflow is declaring components and rendering them into a client, server, or native host; this checkout excerpt also exposes the React Compiler, which transforms eligible functions into memoized code. The compiler workflow is better evidenced here: a Babel entry invokes its pipeline, which lowers source to HIR, infers and validates behavior, forms reactive scopes, and generates code. The tree also shows a Rust compiler bridge and browser playground. Core React renderer implementations are not sampled, so their internal wiring is omitted.
